name: Case study results strip
purpose: Summarises the customer-story index with five challenge-to-outcome stats, each attributed to a named customer, then sends readers to the demo.
description: Page-local function on /case-studies/lms: a centred H2 and grey paragraph in a 50rem column, then a single 6-track grid `repeat(5, min-content) 1fr` of five dark cards, each as wide as its stat (clipped by the page section on mobile rather than wrapping). Each card shows a brand-green challenge label, the customer logo, a 64px stat (48/40px on smaller breakpoints) and a grey result sentence ending in the linked customer name. A centred primary button follows. Differs from the shared Results block in grid behaviour, labels and the trailing customer link.
